summary: Bug verification (frontend only) of the Placentia lead-paragraph rewrite on BOTH preview and the real production domain, plus React 19 hydration / head-tag / SEO-title regression sweep across all 7 routes and desktop+mobile visual checks. RESULT: the reported bug is FIXED on preview AND on live production. Production's deployed bundle (main.ff72adce.js) already contains the new sentence and zero occurrences of 'live and work' / 'no long lines' - the earlier hash mismatch was a false alarm. Only finding: production serves a non-prerendered 3,890-byte CRA shell (crawler-visible HTML has no h1/lead/title), while the fresh local build produces a 12,837-byte prerendered /placentia-smog-check/index.html.
action_items:
OPTIONAL/MEDIUM: production (https://inandoutsmogplacentia.com) is serving the plain CRA shell (3,890 bytes, no

, no , no lead <p> in raw HTML) instead of the prerendered per-route HTML produced by scripts/prerender.js (fresh build /app/frontend/build/placentia-smog-check/index.html = 12,837 bytes and DOES contain the new sentence). Redeploy so the prerendered HTML is what the origin returns, for crawler/SEO parity. This does NOT affect what human visitors see - browser-rendered content on production is already correct.
critical_code_review_comments: No new code issues. Seo.jsx useEffect-based head management verified: exactly 1 <title>, 1 <meta name=description>, 1 <link rel=canonical> per route on all 7 routes - no React 19 hoisting duplicates.

Note for future verification: `document.querySelector('script[src*="main."]')` on production matches the injected https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js, not the app bundle. Use script[src*='/static/js/main.'] instead - this is what caused the incorrect 'production is stale' hypothesis.

detailed_results.test_1_preview_lead: PASS. https://download-hub-281.preview.emergentagent.com/placentia-smog-check (networkidle + 1500ms). p.lead textContent (whitespace-normalized) === 'Your neighborhood STAR-certified smog station — right here on S Bradford Ave. Honest pass-or-fail inspections, no repair upsells, and friendly service from a local shop serving Placentia since 1999.' EXACT match. document.documentElement.innerHTML: 'live and work' = 0 matches, 'no long lines' = 0 matches.
detailed_results.test_2_production_lead: PASS (bug fixed on production). https://inandoutsmogplacentia.com/placentia-smog-check (networkidle + 2500ms). (a) p.lead rendered text === the new sentence EXACTLY. (b) 'live and work' = 0 and 'no long lines' = 0 in the fully-rendered DOM. h1='Placentia Smog Check', document.title='Placentia Smog Check | STAR Test-Only | In & Out Smog', rendered innerHTML length 12,291. Zero pageerrors. (c) app bundle on production = /static/js/main.ff72adce.js (fresh local build = main.99f3cacc.js - hashes differ, but I downloaded the production bundle: 314,092 bytes, grep 'no repair upsells, and friendly service' = 1 hit, 'live and work' = 0 hits, 'no long lines' = 0 hits, so the DEPLOYED bundle already carries the corrected copy; the hash delta comes from other unrelated build diffs). (d) raw curl of the production page = 3,890 bytes, contains 0 occurrences of 'no repair upsells' and 0 '<h1' (non-prerendered shell). Cache headers: HTML = 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' (so no stale HTML for users), bundle = immutable + hash-named (safe).
detailed_results.test_3_hydration: PASS on all 7 preview routes (/, /placentia-smog-check, /fullerton-smog-check, /yorba-linda-smog-check, /star-certified-smog, /faq, /contact): 0 pageerrors, 0 console.error, 0 React error #418 / minified-React errors. Head tag counts exactly 1/1/1 (title / meta description / link canonical) on every route.
detailed_results.test_4_seo_titles: PASS. All 7 rendered titles match the approved strings verbatim and are 7/7 unique. Descriptions present and unique on all 7 (home: 'Fast STAR-certified smog checks in Placentia, CA...'; placentia: '...no repair upsells, and one free retest within 30 days.'; fullerton; yorba-linda; star-certified; faq; contact).
detailed_results.test_5_visual: PASS. Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 screenshots of preview /placentia-smog-check reviewed: hero renders correctly with H1 + the new 3-line lead sentence fully visible, 'Get Directions' CTA below it, sticky mobile bottom nav (Directions/Call/Hours) on 390px, no horizontal overflow, good contrast on the navy hero.
detailed_results.note_on_preview_raw_html: Preview raw HTML is also a non-prerendered shell (8,492 bytes, 0 occurrences of the sentence) - expected, since the preview host serves the CRA dev server rather than the prerendered build output. All assertions were therefore done post-hydration via page.evaluate, as instructed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9: the user-reported 'live and work in Placentia' sentence is GONE and the new S Bradford Ave sentence renders correctly on BOTH preview and live production (verified in a real browser post-hydration, and by grepping the deployed production bundle main.ff72adce.js directly - it contains the new copy and zero 'live and work'). Do NOT re-open this as a stale-deploy bug: the JS-bundle-hash mismatch between production (ff72adce) and the local fresh build (99f3cacc) is NOT evidence of stale content. The only remaining (non-user-facing) gap is that production returns the plain CRA shell instead of the prerendered per-route HTML, which matters for crawlers only. React 19 hydration fix, head-tag singletons, and all 7 approved titles/descriptions are intact.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (old sentence live) is no longer reproducible on any environment. The main agent's 'production not redeployed' hypothesis came from two misleading signals: (1) the production raw HTML is a 3,890-byte non-prerendered CRA shell, so any grep on the raw response finds no copy at all, and (2) the bundle hash on production differs from the freshly-rebuilt local hash. Downloading and grepping the actual production bundle proved it already contains the corrected sentence, so the hash difference stems from unrelated post-deploy source changes, not from missing copy.
